title: HVAC Tips for the Holidays
desc: Are you in need of HVAC tips this holiday season? Call our team at Rosenberg Indoor Comfort today to learn more about our services!

blocks.text: As the weather gets colder, you will rely on your HVAC system to keep your home comfortable and warm. This is especially true during the holiday season.

If you are like most people, it is your busiest time of the year. From going shopping to attending holiday parties, it is easy to neglect basic tasks such as HVAC maintenance. Here are 5 HVAC tips for the holidays.

Your heating system must be properly maintained if you want to prevent unexpected breakdowns. Schedule a maintenance service with Rosenberg Plumbing & Air at least once a year. A routine maintenance service can extend the life of your system. It can boost your system’s efficiency and decrease your energy bills.
A carbon monoxide leak can be hazardous to your health, so be sure to install a carbon monoxide detector in your home. Be sure to replace the batteries as needed.

Did you know that many HVAC system fires occur during the holiday season? The primary cause of these fires is a dirty HVAC system. Debris can build up in your system. It’s a good idea to have it cleaned by a skilled technician at Rosenberg Plumbing & Air.

Running your HVAC system all day can be costly. A good way to prevent a high heating bill after the holidays is to set your programmable thermostat. While you’re running holiday errands, program your thermostat at lower settings.
Dirty air filters can make your HVAC system work harder than usual. As a result, your system’s efficiency will decrease. Replace your HVAC system’s filters every two months.
